_comment: Phase A per-repo baseline. Dropped into <repo>/.claude/settings.json by claude-code-rig/bin/init-repo when a repo has no settings file. The 22 mcp__serena__* allow rules below mirror the global allow-set in ~/.claude/settings.json (canonical superset). Per-repo additions go directly into <repo>/.claude/settings.json after this baseline lands; they are not reflected back to the global. To grow the baseline, edit this file and run claude-code-rig/remediate.sh --apply.
